from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
d=Path(sys.argv[1]); p=d/'_probe/pilot_test.go'; l=p.read_text().splitlines()
values={
'duplicate success state':'Two true calls on a single half-open completion can leave the breaker Closed.',
'after abandonment:':'An omitted completion can leave a half-open breaker rejecting a later call with ErrTooManyRequests.',
'state notifications before':'Calling a stale report can trigger a HalfOpen notification before another admission.',
'counts before first returns':'The second Execute can complete and count its result while the first remains pending.',
'same-goroutine State reentry returned':'The probe expects the callback State reentry not to return in its observation window.',
'counts=%+v calls':'A policy panic can lead to two closed failure-accounting attempts for one admission.',
'got != "notification"':'The notification panic replaces the original request panic in this schedule.',
'transition did not commit':'State Open and zeroed counts remain committed when notification panics.',
'second admission after open expiry':'The first post-expiry Allow can consume the sole half-open slot.'
}
a=[]
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(values.items(),1):
 n=next(i for i,s in enumerate(l,1) if k in s)
 a.append(dict(id=f'probe-{i:02}',kind='claim',statement=v,line=n,fragment=l[n-1].strip()))
(d/'verify-probes.checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n')
